name: ship
description: Subagent driving an approved change from branch → PR → external review → merge in one autonomous flow. External review via the `pr-review` subagent (which runs the agent-tool-pr-reviewer CLI in multi-model consensus mode: Claude Opus 4.7 + GPT-5.3 Codex + Gemini 3.1 Pro); falls back to the `/code-review` plugin if it's unavailable.
